API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APILocation ManagementLocations Group Resource Get Groups
Locations Group Resource Get Groups
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/locations/groups

Gets information on location groups. To learn more, see About Location Groups.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
version
int32

The version parameter is for Zscaler internal use only. The version is used by the service for backup operations.

Default value: 0
name
string

The location group's name

groupType
string

The location group's type (i.e., Static or Dynamic)

comments
string

Additional comments or information about the location group

locationId
int32

The unique identifier for a location within a location group

lastModUser
string

The admin that last modified the group

fetchLocations
boolean

Fetches locations associated with the group. Set the value to 'false' to avoid fetching associated locations, thereby optimizing the GET location groups endpoint.

Default value: true
page
int32

Specifies the page offset

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 100, but the maximum size is 1000.

Default value: 100
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

Unique identifier for the location group

name
string
REQUIRED

Location group name

deleted
boolean

Indicates the location group was deleted

groupType
string

The location group's type (i.e., Static or Dynamic)

Possible values: [STATIC_GROUP, DYNAMIC_GROUP]

dynamicLocationGroupCriteria
object
locations
object[]
comments
string

Additional information about the location group

lastModUser
object
lastModTime
int32

Automatically populated with the current time, after a successful POST or PUT request.

predefined
boolean
]
